name: Enplas Corporation
summary: Enplas Corporation engages in the semiconductor, life science, network, display, and energy saving solution businesses in Japan. It offers energy saving solutions, including turbo impeller, mesh filter, and wesco pump, as well as double helical, crowing, face, and high precision gears; and semiconductor solutions comprising general-purpose IC socket and burn in sockets.
